quote: Run many independent chains simultaneously on one or more GPUs, each chain on its own device or thread
reason: Independent chains are the same computation run side by side; each chain stays strictly sequential, removing no step dependency.

quote: compute batched likelihoods for many parameter vectors concurrently on the GPU, vectorizing surrogate evaluation across parameters and time windows
reason: Surrogate changes what is computed, enabling batched GPU likelihoods; the chain still waits on each likelihood, and batching is across parameter vectors.

quote: propagate, reweight, and resample particles level by level, parallelizing the per-particle likelihood and proposal work
reason: SMC changes the sampler, but tempering levels remain sequential; per-particle work is independent items evaluated side by side.

quote: where possible, use associative scans or linearized operators to parallelize the time recurrence
reason: Associative scans reassociate the recurrence so time steps are computed simultaneously, removing the step-after-step dependency.

quote: Parallelize independent catchment-level MCMC samplers over many GPUs or workers
reason: Independent catchment samplers run side by side; each chain remains sequential, and async aggregation avoids waiting rather than parallelizing steps.
